items.title: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
items.title_ko: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
items.summary_ko: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, including artificial intelligence and data centers.

items.title: SK Hynix Leveraged Funds to Be Delisted in US as AI Rally Cools
items.title_ko: SK Hynix Leveraged Funds to Be Delisted in US as AI Rally Cools
items.summary_ko: Two leveraged exchange-traded funds tied to SK Hynix Inc. will be liquidated just months after their debut in the US, as investor appetite for the artificial intelligence trade moderates.

items.title: Australian Regulator Warns Higher Market Risks May Hit Liquidity
items.title_ko: Australian Regulator Warns Higher Market Risks May Hit Liquidity
items.summary_ko: Australia’s regulator warned that ructions in the global bond market and elevated concerns linked to artificial intelligence are threatening to weaken financial market liquidity.

items.title: Thailand Imports Surge at Record Pace on AI, Energy Demand
items.title_ko: Thailand Imports Surge at Record Pace on AI, Energy Demand
items.summary_ko: Thailand’s imports surged at the fastest pace on record in September as higher energy costs and an investment boom in artificial intelligence and advanced electronics drove demand for fuel and capital goods.

items.title: EM Stocks Fall Before Key Earnings, Brazil in Focus as Lula Wins
items.title_ko: EM Stocks Fall Before Key Earnings, Brazil in Focus as Lula Wins
items.summary_ko: Emerging-market stocks started the week lower as investors awaited earnings from some of the world’s biggest technology companies for clues on whether the artificial intelligence trade can recover from a bruising selloff.

items.title: Copper Extends Drop as AI Stocks Weigh Ahead of Fed Meeting
items.title_ko: Copper Extends Drop as AI Stocks Weigh Ahead of Fed Meeting
items.summary_ko: Copper extended last week’s drop as artificial intelligence stocks came under further pressure, sapping risk appetite ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting.

items.title: Asset Manager Australian Dollar Shorts Hit Record on Risk-Off
items.title_ko: Asset Manager Australian Dollar Shorts Hit Record on Risk-Off
items.summary_ko: Asset managers’ short positions on the Australian dollar surged to a record high in the week ended Oct. 20, as mounting Middle East tensions and jitters over the artificial intelligence trade spurred a retreat from the risk-sensitive currency.

items.title_ko: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
items.summary_ko: Elon Musk said in an X post that SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs.

items.title: SK Hynix Shares Defy AI Selloff With Help From Kioxia Gains
items.title_ko: SK Hynix Shares Defy AI Selloff With Help From Kioxia Gains
items.summary_ko: SK Hynix Inc.’s shares bucked a broad selloff in AI-related stocks thanks to the prospect of a hefty dividend payout related to the South Korean memory maker’s stake in Japan’s Kioxia Holdings Corp.

items.summary_ko: Asia’s busiest earnings week will put the AI trade to a major test as investors look for proof that billions in investment are translating into profits, and that growth is spreading beyond tech.

items.title: Stocks Edge Up With Treasuries, Crude Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
items.title_ko: Stocks Edge Up With Treasuries, Crude Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
items.summary_ko: Stocks edged higher as investors rotated out of the artificial intelligence trade ahead of key tech earnings this week that will offer clues on whether the recent pullback has further to run. Treasuries rose and oil declined.

items.title: Musk Claims $40 Billion Chips Debt Closed, Yet Talks Ongoing
items.title_ko: Musk Claims $40 Billion Chips Debt Closed, Yet Talks Ongoing
items.summary_ko: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt deal to pay for the chips it needs to fuel its artificial intelligence ambitions. People familiar with the discussions, though, told Bloomberg News that talks over pricing were still ongoing.
